title: Identify the end points
text: We saw that the domain is $$[-1,1]$$ and the range is $$[0, \pi].$$ We know that when $$x=1, $$ $$\theta=0;$$ when $$x=-1, $$ $$\theta=\pi.$$

title: Compare domains and ranges
text: We see that A is the only viable option as it has the correct domain, range and behavior at the end points.
